raw.head: PersonX and PersonY attend a business meeting
raw.literal: Lenora and Merci attend a business meeting. Now Lenora is impressed by Merci.
raw.narrative: After the business meeting, Lenora was very impressed by Merci. She thought she was a very smart and articulate person.
dialogue: I'm really impressed by how you handled the meeting just now. You're very smart and articulate.
Thank you, Lenora. I appreciate your compliments. I've worked hard to hone my skills in both areas.
It shows. You have a lot of excellent ideas, and you communicate them well.
Thank you again. I'm glad you think so highly of my abilities.
Oh, I do! In fact, I was wondering if you might be interested in joining our team at the marketing firm I work for. We could use someone with your talents on board.
That sounds like a great opportunity! I would love to join your team. Thank you for considering me.
